sentences.s: When prehistoric man arrived in new parts of the world, something strange happened to the large animals: they suddenly became extinct.

trunk.主干翻译: 大型动物身上发生了奇怪的事情。

components.原文: When prehistoric man arrived in new parts of the world
components.中文翻译: 当史前人类到达世界各地的新地区时
components.说明: 由 When 引导的时间状语从句。

components.原文: they suddenly became extinct
components.修饰对象: something strange happened to the large animals
components.中文翻译: 它们突然灭绝了
components.说明: 冒号后的分句，对 something strange 作具体解释，they 指代 the large animals。

sentences.zh: 当史前人类到达世界各地的新地区时，大型动物身上发生了奇怪的事情：它们突然灭绝了。

sentences.s: Smaller species survived.

trunk.主干翻译: 较小的物种存活了下来。

sentences.zh: 较小的物种存活了下来。

sentences.s: The large, slow-growing animals were easy game, and were quickly hunted to extinction.

trunk.主干翻译: 这些大型的、生长缓慢的动物是容易捕获的猎物。

components.原文: were quickly hunted to extinction
components.中文翻译: 很快就被猎杀至灭绝
components.说明: and 连接的第二个并列谓语，与前面的 were easy game 共用主语。

sentences.zh: 这些大型的、生长缓慢的动物是容易捕获的猎物，很快就被猎杀至灭绝。

sentences.s: Now something similar could be happening in the oceans.

trunk.主干翻译: 类似的事情可能正在海洋中发生。

sentences.zh: 如今，类似的事情可能正在海洋中发生。

sentences.s: That the seas are being overfished has been known for years.

trunk.主语: That the seas are being overfished
trunk.主干翻译: （某事）多年来已为人所知。

components.原文: That the seas are being overfished
components.中文翻译: 海洋正在被过度捕捞（这一事实）
components.说明: That 引导主语从句作整句主语，谓语为 has been known。

sentences.zh: 海洋正在被过度捕捞这一事实，多年来早已为人所知。

sentences.s: What researchers such as Ransom Myers and Boris Worm have shown is just how fast things are changing.

trunk.主语: What researchers such as Ransom Myers and Boris Worm have shown
trunk.宾语或表语: just how fast things are changing
trunk.主干翻译: （研究者们）所揭示的是事情变化的速度有多快。

components.原文: What researchers such as Ransom Myers and Boris Worm have shown
components.中文翻译: 诸如兰塞姆·迈尔斯和鲍里斯·沃姆这样的研究者所揭示的内容
components.说明: What 引导主语从句作整句主语。

components.原文: just how fast things are changing
components.中文翻译: 事情变化的速度究竟有多快
components.说明: how 引导表语从句，作系动词 is 的表语。

sentences.zh: 诸如兰塞姆·迈尔斯和鲍里斯·沃姆这样的研究者所揭示的，正是事情变化的速度究竟有多快。

sentences.s: They have looked at half a century of data from fisheries around the world.

trunk.主干翻译: 他们研究了半个世纪的数据。

components.原文: from fisheries around the world
components.中文翻译: 来自世界各地渔场的
components.说明: from... 介词短语作后置定语修饰 data。

sentences.zh: 他们研究了来自世界各地渔场的半个世纪的数据。

sentences.s: Their methods do not attempt to estimate the actual biomass (the amount of living biological matter) of fish species in particular parts of the ocean, but rather changes in that biomass over time.

trunk.主干翻译: 他们的方法并不试图估算……而是（估算）……

components.原文: to estimate the actual biomass (the amount of living biological matter) of fish species in particular parts of the ocean
components.中文翻译: 去估算海洋特定区域内鱼类物种的实际生物量
components.说明: 动词不定式作 attempt 的宾语，估算的对象是 actual biomass。

components.原文: the amount of living biological matter
components.中文翻译: 即活体生物物质的总量
components.说明: 括号内成分作 biomass 的同位语，对其加以解释。

components.原文: but rather changes in that biomass over time
components.中文翻译: 而是（估算）该生物量随时间的变化
components.说明: but rather 连接的并列宾语，与前面的 the actual biomass 并列作 estimate 的宾语。

sentences.zh: 他们的方法并不试图估算海洋特定区域内鱼类物种的实际生物量（即活体生物物质的总量），而是估算该生物量随时间的变化。

sentences.s: According to their latest paper published in Nature, the biomass of large predators (animals that kill and eat other animals) in a new fishery is reduced on average by 80% within 15 years of the start of exploitation.

trunk.主干翻译: 大型捕食者的生物量平均减少了80%。

components.原文: published in Nature
components.中文翻译: 发表在《自然》杂志上的
components.说明: 过去分词短语作后置定语修饰 their latest paper。

components.原文: According to their latest paper published in Nature
components.中文翻译: 根据他们发表在《自然》杂志上的最新论文
components.说明: According to 介词短语作全句状语，交代信息来源。

components.原文: animals that kill and eat other animals
components.中文翻译: 即那些捕杀并吃掉其他动物的动物
components.说明: 括号内成分作 large predators 的同位语。

components.原文: that kill and eat other animals
components.中文翻译: 捕杀并吃掉其他动物的
components.说明: that 引导定语从句修饰 animals。

components.原文: kill and eat other animals
components.中文翻译: 捕杀并吃掉其他动物
components.说明: and 连接 kill 与 eat 两个并列谓语动词。

components.原文: within 15 years of the start of exploitation
components.中文翻译: 在开始捕捞后的15年内
components.说明: within... 介词短语作时间状语，限定减少发生的时间。

sentences.zh: 根据他们发表在《自然》杂志上的最新论文，一片新渔场中大型捕食者（即那些捕杀并吃掉其他动物的动物）的生物量，在开始捕捞后的15年内平均减少了80%。

sentences.s: In some long-fished areas, it has halved again since then.

trunk.主干翻译: 它又减少了一半。

components.原文: In some long-fished areas
components.中文翻译: 在一些长期捕捞的区域
components.说明: In... 介词短语作地点状语。

sentences.zh: 在一些长期捕捞的区域，自那以后它又减少了一半。

sentences.s: Dr. Worm acknowledges that these figures are conservative.

trunk.主干翻译: 沃姆博士承认（某事）。

components.原文: that these figures are conservative
components.中文翻译: 这些数字是保守的
components.说明: that 引导宾语从句作 acknowledges 的宾语。

sentences.zh: 沃姆博士承认这些数字是偏保守的。

sentences.s: One reason for this is that fishing technology has improved.

trunk.主干翻译: 造成这种情况的一个原因是（某事）。

components.原文: that fishing technology has improved
components.中文翻译: 捕鱼技术已经提高了
components.说明: that 引导表语从句，作系动词 is 的表语。

sentences.zh: 造成这种情况的一个原因是捕鱼技术已经提高了。

sentences.s: Today's vessels can find their prey using satellites and sonar, which were not available 50 years ago.

trunk.主干翻译: 如今的船只能够找到它们的猎物。

components.原文: using satellites and sonar
components.中文翻译: 利用卫星和声呐
components.说明: 现在分词短语作方式状语，说明 find 的手段。

components.原文: which were not available 50 years ago
components.中文翻译: 这些（设备）在50年前还无法获得
components.说明: which 引导非限制性定语从句修饰 satellites and sonar。

sentences.zh: 如今的船只能够利用卫星和声呐找到它们的猎物，而这些设备在50年前还无法获得。

sentences.s: That means a higher proportion of what is in the sea is being caught, so the real difference between present and past is likely to be worse than the one recorded by changes in catch sizes.

trunk.宾语或表语: a higher proportion ... is being caught
trunk.主干翻译: 这意味着（某事）。

components.原文: a higher proportion of what is in the sea is being caught
components.中文翻译: 海洋中更高比例的鱼正在被捕捞
components.说明: 省略 that 的宾语从句作 means 的宾语。

components.原文: what is in the sea
components.中文翻译: 海洋中所有的（鱼）
components.说明: what 引导名词性从句，作介词 of 的宾语。

components.原文: so the real difference between present and past is likely to be worse than the one recorded by changes in catch sizes
components.中文翻译: 因此，现在与过去之间的真实差距很可能比捕获量变化所记录的差距更糟
components.说明: so 连接的并列分句，表示结果。

components.原文: to be worse than the one recorded by changes in catch sizes
components.中文翻译: （很可能）比由捕获量变化所记录的那个差距更糟
components.说明: be likely to do 结构中的不定式，作 likely 的补足成分。

components.原文: recorded by changes in catch sizes
components.中文翻译: 由捕获量变化所记录的
components.说明: 过去分词短语作后置定语修饰 the one（指 difference）。

components.原文: than the one recorded by changes in catch sizes
components.中文翻译: 比捕获量变化所记录的那个差距
components.说明: than 引导比较状语，与 worse 构成比较结构。

sentences.zh: 这意味着海洋中更高比例的鱼正在被捕捞，因此现在与过去之间的真实差距很可能比仅由捕获量变化所记录的差距还要糟糕。

sentences.s: In the early days, too, longlines would have been more saturated with fish.

trunk.主干翻译: 延绳钓的鱼会更密集。

components.原文: In the early days
components.中文翻译: 在早期
components.说明: In... 介词短语作时间状语。

components.原文: too
components.中文翻译: 而且
components.说明: too 作插入性补充成分，承接上文。

sentences.zh: 而且，在早期，延绳钓上挂着的鱼也会更加密集。

sentences.s: Some individuals would therefore not have been caught, since no baited hooks would have been available to trap them, leading to an underestimate of fish stocks in the past.

trunk.主干翻译: 有些个体本不会被捕到。

components.原文: since no baited hooks would have been available to trap them
components.中文翻译: 因为当时没有带饵的鱼钩可以捕捉它们
components.说明: since 引导原因状语从句。

components.原文: to trap them
components.中文翻译: 来捕捉它们
components.说明: 不定式作状语，说明 hooks 的用途/目的。

components.原文: leading to an underestimate of fish stocks in the past
components.中文翻译: 从而导致对过去鱼类资源量的低估
components.说明: 现在分词短语作结果状语，表示主句行为带来的结果。

sentences.zh: 因此，有些个体本不会被捕到，因为当时没有带饵的鱼钩可以捕捉它们，从而导致了对过去鱼类资源量的低估。

sentences.s: Furthermore, in the early days of longline fishing, a lot of fish were lost to sharks after they had been hooked.

trunk.主干翻译: 大量的鱼被鲨鱼夺走。

components.原文: Furthermore
components.中文翻译: 此外
components.说明: 连接性副词作插入语，承接上文递进。

components.原文: in the early days of longline fishing
components.中文翻译: 在延绳钓捕鱼的早期
components.说明: in... 介词短语作时间状语。

components.原文: after they had been hooked
components.中文翻译: 在它们被钓住之后
components.说明: after 引导时间状语从句。

sentences.zh: 此外，在延绳钓捕鱼的早期，许多鱼在被钓住之后便被鲨鱼夺走了。

sentences.s: That is no longer a problem, because there are fewer sharks around now.

trunk.主干翻译: 那不再是个问题。

components.原文: because there are fewer sharks around now
components.中文翻译: 因为现在周围的鲨鱼少了
components.说明: because 引导原因状语从句。

sentences.zh: 如今那已不再是个问题，因为现在周围的鲨鱼少了。

sentences.s: Dr. Myers and Dr. Worm argue that their work gives a correct baseline, which future management efforts must take into account.

trunk.宾语或表语: that their work gives a correct baseline
trunk.主干翻译: 迈尔斯博士和沃姆博士认为（某事）。

components.原文: that their work gives a correct baseline, which future management efforts must take into account
components.中文翻译: 他们的工作提供了一个正确的基准
components.说明: that 引导宾语从句作 argue 的宾语。

components.原文: which future management efforts must take into account
components.中文翻译: 未来的管理工作必须将其纳入考虑
components.说明: which 引导非限制性定语从句修饰 baseline。

sentences.zh: 迈尔斯博士和沃姆博士认为，他们的工作提供了一个正确的基准，未来的管理工作必须将其纳入考虑。

sentences.s: They believe the data support an idea current among marine biologists, that of the "shifting baseline".

trunk.主干翻译: 他们相信这些数据支持一种观点。

components.原文: the data support an idea current among marine biologists, that of the "shifting baseline"
components.中文翻译: 这些数据支持一种在海洋生物学家中流行的观点
components.说明: 省略 that 的宾语从句作 believe 的宾语。

components.原文: current among marine biologists
components.中文翻译: 在海洋生物学家中流行的
components.说明: 形容词短语作后置定语修饰 idea。

components.原文: that of the "shifting baseline"
components.中文翻译: 即"基准移动"的观点
components.说明: that of... 作 an idea 的同位语，进一步解释该观点。

sentences.zh: 他们相信，这些数据支持一种在海洋生物学家中流行的观点，即"基准移动"的观点。

sentences.s: The notion is that people have failed to detect the massive changes which have happened in the ocean because they have been looking back only a relatively short time into the past.

trunk.宾语或表语: that people have failed to detect the massive changes
trunk.主干翻译: 这种观点是（某事）。

components.原文: that people have failed to detect the massive changes which have happened in the ocean because they have been looking back only a relatively short time into the past
components.中文翻译: 人们未能察觉到海洋中发生的巨大变化
components.说明: that 引导表语从句，作系动词 is 的表语。

components.原文: to detect the massive changes which have happened in the ocean
components.中文翻译: 去察觉海洋中发生的巨大变化
components.说明: 不定式作 fail 的宾语补足成分。

components.原文: which have happened in the ocean
components.中文翻译: 已经在海洋中发生的
components.说明: which 引导定语从句修饰 the massive changes。

components.原文: because they have been looking back only a relatively short time into the past
components.中文翻译: 因为他们回溯的过去时间相对较短
components.说明: because 引导原因状语从句，说明未能察觉变化的原因。

sentences.zh: 这种观点是：人们之所以未能察觉到海洋中发生的巨大变化，是因为他们回溯的过去时间相对较短。

sentences.s: That matters because theory suggests that the maximum sustainable yield that can be cropped from a fishery comes when the biomass of a target species is about 50% of its original levels.

trunk.主干翻译: 这一点很重要。

components.原文: because theory suggests that the maximum sustainable yield that can be cropped from a fishery comes when the biomass of a target species is about 50% of its original levels
components.中文翻译: 因为理论表明……
components.说明: because 引导原因状语从句，解释为何重要。

components.原文: that the maximum sustainable yield that can be cropped from a fishery comes when the biomass of a target species is about 50% of its original levels
components.中文翻译: 可从渔场获取的最大可持续产量出现在……之时
components.说明: that 引导宾语从句作 suggests 的宾语。

components.原文: that can be cropped from a fishery
components.中文翻译: 可从渔场中获取的
components.说明: that 引导定语从句修饰 the maximum sustainable yield。

components.原文: when the biomass of a target species is about 50% of its original levels
components.中文翻译: 当目标物种的生物量约为其原有水平的50%时
components.说明: when 引导时间状语从句，修饰宾语从句中的谓语 comes。

sentences.zh: 这一点很重要，因为理论表明，可从渔场获取的最大可持续产量出现在目标物种的生物量约为其原有水平50%之时。

sentences.s: Most fisheries are well below that, which is a bad way to do business.

trunk.主干翻译: 大多数渔场远低于那个水平。

components.原文: which is a bad way to do business
components.中文翻译: 这是一种糟糕的经营方式
components.说明: which 引导非限制性定语从句，修饰前面整个句子（指渔场远低于该水平这一情况）。

components.原文: to do business
components.中文翻译: 做生意的
components.说明: 不定式作后置定语修饰 a bad way。

sentences.zh: 大多数渔场都远低于那个水平，而这是一种糟糕的经营方式。
